लस्तक, perhaps लस्त + क (1. लस्, To embrace). m. The middle of a bow.

लास, i. e. लस् + अ, m.
 1. Dancing. []
 2.
. Pea-water, pulse that has been lightly boiled.

लासक, i. e. लस् + अक,
 I. m.
 1. A dancer, an actor.
 2. A peacock.
 II. f. अका and इका, A dancing girl.

लास्य, i. e. लास + य,
 I. m. A dancer.
 II. f. या, A female dancer.
 III. n.
 1.
. Union of dance and music, Mārk.
. The dance of the Indian dancing girls.
